dialogue.title: 对话
resp.gift_friendly: 慷慨的礼物！你真是太好了。
resp.already_known: 是啊，我早就知道了。不过还是谢谢你来确认。
resp.learned: 有意思...这我之前没听说过。多谢。
ui.map_placeholder: 只显示你曾经去过的地方...
quest.label: [任务]
quest.accepted: 谢谢你。完成后回来找我。
quest.reward: 非常感谢。这是给你的报酬。
quest.not_done: 任务还没有完成。请继续努力。
quest.find_brother.title: 寻找我弟弟
quest.find_brother.desc: 商人Nabu在乌加里特陷落时与弟弟失散。最后一次看见他是在去比布鲁斯的路上。
quest.deliver_letter.title: 送出国王的信
quest.deliver_letter.desc: Hatt队长需要把一封密信送到神庙。他不信任普通的信使。
quest.copper_shipment.title: 铜矿货物
quest.copper_shipment.desc: 铁匠Hepar需要塞浦路斯的铜。找一个知道贸易路线的水手。
quest.copper_shipment.obj: 向水手Wenamun询问塞浦路斯贸易路线
quest.defend_camp.title: 保护难民营
quest.defend_camp.desc: 难民Mara警告掠夺者正在逼近。在她附近击败5个敌人。
fact.ugarit_sack.merchant_1: 港口在夜间被攻陷了。我带着账本勉强逃了出来。
fact.sea_peoples.merchant_1: 他们来自西方——我从没见过那样的船。
fact.byblos_king.guard_1: 国王越来越绝望了。他一直在请求外国军队支援。
fact.sea_peoples.guard_1: 他们先袭击了乌加里特。我们正在加固城墙。
fact.sea_peoples.pirate_1: 他们不是你应该害怕的敌人，小商人。
fact.copper_trade.pirate_1: 塞浦路斯还在运铜。暂时。
fact.ugarit_sack.priest_1: 众神已经抛弃了我们。预兆已经很清楚了。
fact.byblos_king.priest_1: 国王每天都在献祭。他害怕的不只是海上民族。
fact.ugarit_sack.refugee_1: 我失去了一切。我的丈夫，我的家……火光在数里外都能看见。
fact.sea_peoples.refugee_1: 他们不抓俘虏。他们烧掉一切。
fact.copper_trade.smith_1: 这个季度铜价翻了三倍。战争对我的生意有好处，但对我的灵魂不好。
fact.byblos_king.smith_1: 他上周订购了一千个矛头。一千个。
fact.copper_trade.scribe_1: 宫殿档案记录了两百年来自阿拉西亚的铜矿运输。现在那些档案都成了灰烬。
fact.byblos_king.scribe_1: 比布鲁斯国王上个月派使者去了埃及。法老拒绝了他们。
fact.sea_peoples.sailor_1: 我在地平线上看到了他们的船。这个季节已经三次了。他们像秃鹫一样在盘旋。
fact.copper_trade.sailor_1: 到阿拉西亚的贸易路线仍然开放——如果你够勇敢的话。没有多少人敢走。
fact.sea_peoples.warlord_1: 我上周失去了三个人。他们比人们想象的更有组织。
fact.sea_peoples.mercenary_captain: 我被雇来保护商队。双倍酬劳。每个人都很害怕。
fact.byblos_king.mercenary_captain: 国王为了刀剑出价很高。但忠诚比黄金便宜。
fact.sea_peoples.hunter_1: 我在北岸发现了他们的踪迹。他们派了侦察兵深入内陆。
fact.copper_trade.hunter_1: 旧商路不安全。上个月我看见一支商队被伏击了。
fact.sea_peoples.fisher_1: 我从我的船上看到了他们的船。他们三艘一组——两艘攻击，一艘待命。
fact.copper_trade.fisher_1: 塞浦路斯的船还会经过。比以前少了，但还是有。
fact.ugarit_sack.healer_1: 我治疗了幸存者。他们讲的故事……我无法复述。
fact.byblos_king.healer_1: 国王的御医上周买走了我所有的药。有重要人物生病了。
fact.ugarit_sack.beggar_1: 他们来的时候我在下城。那些尖叫声……我至今还能听到。
fact.byblos_king.beggar_1: 富人逃往北方。穷人等死。一直都是这样。
mp.title: 多人联机
mp.hosting_hint: 告诉你的朋友用你的IP地址连接
fact.thornhaven_fall.merchant_1: The raid came at dawn. I barely grabbed my ledger before the gate fell.
fact.ashen_pact.merchant_1: They wear grey cloaks and speak in whispers. I've seen them watching the old road.
fact.ironholt_warden.guard_1: The Warden has called every able hand to the wall. Something's coming from the peaks.
fact.ashen_pact.guard_1: They struck Thornhaven first. We found strange symbols carved into the ruins.
fact.ashen_pact.pirate_1: The Pact isn't what you should fear, merchant. The things in the deep are waking up.
fact.relic_trade.pirate_1: Mistwood still ships relics. For now. The causeway gets harder to cross each month.
fact.thornhaven_fall.priest_1: I saw it in the smoke three nights before. The old gods have turned their faces away.
fact.ironholt_warden.priest_1: The Warden lights a candle every dusk. He fears more than just the Ashen Pact.
fact.thornhaven_fall.refugee_1: I lost everything. My home, my family... the flames lit the sky for miles.
fact.ashen_pact.refugee_1: They take no prisoners. They leave nothing but ash and silence.
fact.relic_trade.smith_1: The price of iron has tripled this season. War is bad for peace but good for my craft.
fact.ironholt_warden.smith_1: He ordered a thousand spearheads last week. A thousand.
fact.relic_trade.scribe_1: The old archives mention a city beneath the hills. I think Mistwood knows more than it tells.
fact.ironholt_warden.scribe_1: The Warden sent riders to the coast last month. They didn't come back.
fact.ashen_pact.sailor_1: I've seen their grey sails on the horizon. Three times this season. They're circling.
fact.relic_trade.sailor_1: The route to Mistwood is still open if you're brave enough. Few are.
fact.ashen_pact.warlord_1: I lost three good fighters to them last week. They move like they know the ground.
fact.ashen_pact.mercenary_captain: The pay is good for guarding caravans these days. Everyone's scared, and scared people pay double.
fact.ironholt_warden.mercenary_captain: The Warden pays well for swords. But loyalty costs more than gold.
fact.ashen_pact.hunter_1: I found their tracks along the old north road. They have scouts everywhere.
fact.relic_trade.hunter_1: The trade roads aren't safe anymore. I saw a caravan ambushed last full moon.
fact.ashen_pact.fisher_1: I saw their boats from my skiff. They travel in threes — two strike, one waits offshore.
fact.relic_trade.fisher_1: Mistwood boats still pass by. Fewer than before, but they still come.
fact.thornhaven_fall.healer_1: I treated the survivors who made it out. The wounds weren't made by any blade I know.
fact.ironholt_warden.healer_1: The Warden's physician bought all my herbs last week. Someone important is ailing.
fact.thornhaven_fall.beggar_1: I was in the lower ward when they came. The screaming... I still hear it.
fact.ironholt_warden.beggar_1: The rich flee west. The poor die in the mud. It's always been this way.
location.thornhaven.desc: 一座从军事哨站发展起来的泥泞边陲定居点。通往蛮荒之地的北大门。
location.ironholt.desc: 一座嵌入山體的堡壘城鎮。鍛爐日夜不息，城門從未被攻破過。
location.mistwood.desc: 东部雾锁半岛上的定居点。只有在潮位低于堤道时才能到达。
location.duskhollow.desc: 一座建于古老文明废墟之上的港口城镇。深水港中时常见到来自雾海的陌生船只。
service.temple.heading: ⛪ 神殿
service.temple.desc: 圣光充满殿堂。祭司为你净化身心、驱除病痛。
service.blacksmith.heading: 🔧 铁匠铺
service.blacksmith.desc: 炉火正旺。铁匠能为你打磨武器、加固铠甲。
service.inn.heading: 🏨 旅店
service.market.heading: 🏪 市场
